details:
Before I get into this, I have no problem with the team on this game or the actual game itself. I just want this glitch fixed.
Anyway...
A recent problem I've started having is people are vanishing completely off the game!
Description: Whenever I load into a world, often half or all the people in it are gone! Let's say I join a world that says 6/10 in the menu, but it changes to 2/10 once I load in! the people that vanished are invisible, their nameplates are invisible, they have no audio, and even their shields are gone! 
This seems to happen at random, too. strangers and trusted friends vanish without a trace, but this 7 year old kid who has literally been the only one of my "Friends" active lately has been completely fine! 
This issue is also double ended, because a friend (who was the first victim of this glitch) also reported not being able to see me after the glitch fixed the fist time. Oh yeah, that reminds me:
THE GLITCH HAPPENED MULTIPLE TIMES.
The first time, I didn't know it was so big, and thought it was just the one friend. Heck, the glitch even fixed after I turned the game off and on again!
But then it happened again.
And this time, no matter how many times I logged in and out of Oculus or the game, no matter how much I searched for answers, no matter how much stupid Cache I tried to clear... nothing. nothing got rid of this stupid glitch that makes people vanish and removes accounts. Oh yeah, did I forget to mention? IT LITERALLY MAKES ACCOUNTS DISAPPEAR FOR YOU. 
So far, three of my friends have vanished from my friends list, and guess what? when I tried to search for them on the search bar, THEIR ACCOUNTS HAD COMPLETELY DISSAPEARED FROM THE GAME.
Okay, now I've given you info about the glitch, its time to wrap this up with a nice calm description of the other things.
For starters, I only got the game a few weeks ago, so don't know when this glitch ACTUALLY started, but I'm guessing two to three weeks ago. as for the build, I'd say about 2 or three builds ago.
As for how it started, I have no idea.
Welp, that's about it. can you please give multiple ideas this time? because the last time this happened, the only advice was clear your cache. Thanks!
title: People Vanishing!
